summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the rebuilt /services minimal hero-only page. All layout, ordering, responsive grid, navigation, sub-page regression, header/footer render checks PASSED.

issues: Pill body text truncated on desktop (e.g. 'Explore our full range of ins...') due to `truncate` class + 300px pill width. Purely cosmetic and matches spec (short desc + arrow), so not a blocker; consider allowing 2-line clamp if fuller descriptions are desired.

Pills nav bottom (848px) slightly exceeds viewport height (800px) so the last pill requires a tiny scroll on very small mobiles. Spec's pillsInViewport assertion targeted desktop 1440x900 only, so this is acceptable, but flagging for awareness.

assertions.subpage_backlink_stack_regression: PASS on all 4 sub-pages (back link present)
assertions.pill_contents: All 4 pills contain icon (lucide), title, short desc, ArrowUpRight arrow - PASS

critical_code_review_comments: Services.jsx (~130 lines) is clean and focused. Uses semantic <nav aria-label> and data-testids on all critical elements - good testability.
Minor: `truncate` on pill body causes ellipsis on desktop; consider `line-clamp-2` if fuller copy is desired.
No hardcoded URLs, uses react-router <Link>, no _id/MongoDB concerns (frontend-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Services page is a hero-only page with 4 pills. Testids: services-page, services-hero, services-eyebrow, services-headline, services-lede, services-pills, services-pill-{instruments|umr|meditation|events}. Sub-pages at /services/{instruments,music-room,music-meditation,events} render BackLink -> eyebrow -> H1 stack correctly.
